analysis.company_profile: A technology firm delivering AI‑driven language solutions, including large‑language‑model services and machine‑translation, to enterprise customers.

candidate_positioning: Senior AI Engineer with proven end‑to‑end LLM/RAG production experience, strong MLOps background, and solid NLP/anomaly‑detection expertise, ready to extend into MT quality and responsible‑AI governance.

team_needs.need: Design, build and deploy LLM/RAG solutions for NLP use‑cases
team_needs.evidence: Optum: LangGraph analytics system; Viavi: RAG‑based Project Discovery Assistant; Lab extraction agent using Claude + Textract
team_needs.gap: No explicit fine‑tuning of LLMs with TensorFlow/PyTorch; limited exposure to Azure AI Studio/AWS Bedrock.

team_needs.need: Improve machine‑translation quality, implement BLEU/human evaluation pipelines
team_needs.evidence: No direct MT experience; built automated evaluation pipelines for QA agents but not MT‑specific metrics.
team_needs.gap: Lacks hands‑on MT evaluation (BLEU, human scoring) and alignment‑model expertise.

team_needs.need: Data governance, bias detection and mitigation
team_needs.evidence: Created automated evaluation and observability pipelines; cross‑encoder training for retrieval; anomaly detection systems
team_needs.gap: No proven work with bias‑mitigation toolkits (IBM AIF360, Fairlearn) or formal data‑governance frameworks.

team_needs.need: MLOps – CI/CD, model monitoring, drift detection, retraining
team_needs.evidence: MLflow, Docker, Kubernetes, FastAPI deployments; SLA breach prediction system with CI/CD; observability dashboards
Isolation Forest for telecom anomaly detection; SLA breach prediction with real‑time root‑cause analysis

project.name: Adaptive MT Quality & Bias Monitoring System
project.problem: Customer‑facing machine‑translation services suffer from inconsistent quality across language pairs and hidden bias, leading to poor user experience and regulatory risk.
project.approach: Leverage a fine‑tuned LLM (via Azure AI Studio or AWS Bedrock) to generate post‑edited translations; compute BLEU and other automatic metrics; run human‑in‑the‑loop evaluations via a LangChain‑orchestrated workflow; apply alignment models for reference generation; embed Fairlearn/IBM AIF360 for bias detection on translation outputs; orchestrate the entire pipeline with LangGraph, track experiments and model versions in MLflow, and deploy with Docker/Kubernetes for continuous monitoring and drift‑triggered retraining.

requirements_not_covered: Direct machine‑translation system experience and BLEU‑based evaluation
Formal bias‑mitigation implementations with IBM AIF360 or Fairlearn
Experience with Azure Machine Learning Studio, AWS SageMaker, AWS Bedrock, or LlamaIndex
